name: Ichinose Mai
source:
A second-year at Asakura Academy. One half of Kouhei's newfound twin daughters.

A reliable girl who always looks after her flighty big sister, but her personality can be a bit scary. Although her older sister Uta is happy with Kouhei as her papa, Mai can't accept it, and is uptight and mean towards him.
